name: Default
shortDescription: Music streaming server for Squeezebox and compatible players, with a password-protected web UI, library scanning, playlists, internet radio and streaming service plugins.

alerts.message: Sign in with LMS_USERNAME and LMS_PASSWORD from the environment variables. They are written on first start only; change them later under Settings > Advanced > Security.

Only the web port is published. Squeezebox and squeezelite players connect on port 3483 (TCP and UDP), which is not published, so they cannot reach this server; an HTTP player such as VLC can play https://<domain>/stream.mp3 with the same login.
